units.energy: fJ / transported input bit; 32 bits per flit

definitions.no_load: output valid minus input valid; all PCFBs initially empty/ready
definitions.handshake: own input ack low minus own input valid, following own ack high
definitions.acceptance: physical input acknowledge rising at VDD/2
definitions.ii: incoming acceptance spacing, conditioned on current flit class, continuous ready traffic
definitions.parser: internal Serializer I valid to own acknowledge-low processing handshake; not frontend II
definitions.energy: whole-DUT isolated window; pre-state quiet leakage subtracted; divided by 32 transport bits once, including flags
definitions.loaded: network delivery minus injection request; never a router LUT entry

assumptions: Header/first/tail intervals are legal packet-transition intervals, not homogeneous streams.
II is measured with 10 ps polling/slew; valid, accepted and output spacings remain separate.
Saved-node checks cannot directly certify unsaved internal nodes.
Setup processing uses the measured consumed-header handshake as an architectural surrogate.
Optimistic parser values are selected from valid observations; full same-child continuation is set to 31 ns by user instruction.
Fanouts 1 and 4 are measured; 2 and 3 interpolate total per-input energy linearly. Masks with the same fanout share these values.
Parser phase/z/s cells interpolate measured minima; unsupported boundaries use the nearest observed value.
Startup accepted intervals before parser completion are excluded only from steady-state II, not packet setup latency.
Prior and corrected pipeline observations are reused with explicit user authorization.
Nine-bit counters and explicit branch terminators are architectural extensions to the characterized eight-bit circuit.

leakage.reason: No transitions on saved functional nodes; interfaces idle; reset low.

setup.definition: Consumed stop header has no output-valid event; processing_ps/ii_ps use its measured handshake.

phase_definition.initial: First route word, including mask/setup work
phase_definition.continuation: Subsequent route word with nonzero route data, including partial final words
phase_definition.terminator: Subsequent all-zero route-data word; flags are excluded

parser.processing_definition: Serializer input valid to own acknowledge-low; serial parser service per route word
parser.energy_definition: Dynamic whole-router energy per route input flit; never multiplied by payload fanout
parser.interpolation: Measured minimum at each phase/z/s; linear in s then z; nearest boundary outside measured support

user_override.applies_to: All full continuation words sent to one child, including FFFFFFF2 and 88888882
user_override.authorization: User explicitly requested 31 ns for both same-child patterns
